name: Restoran Nasi Kandar Melayu Mad
why: Locals call it the best nasi kandar in Cyber — huge portions, cheap, and the ayam goreng gets constant praise.

name: Umai Cafe
why: Lakefront spot by the Iron Mosque. Nasi lemak with fried chicken, roti jala rendang ayam, and lempeng kelapa for breakfast.

name: Balqis Restaurant
why: Yemeni institution at Shaftsbury — chicken haneeth, lamb kabshah, and mulawah bread made for dipping into fahsah lamb stew.

name: Nasi Kukus Dapur Mama
why: Beloved nasi kukus joint — crispy fried chicken over fragrant rice with killer sambal, wallet-friendly.

name: Serabei Cafe
why: Best asam pedas in the city, plus nasi kerabu, nasi dagang and trays of Malay kuih. Opens 4.30pm — dinner spot.

name: Mohd Chan Restaurant
why: Halal Chinese-Muslim institution — teochew and salted egg dishes, dim sum, crab and lala for family dinners.

name: D'Empangan Udang Galah
why: Everything udang galah (freshwater prawn): fried noodles, stews, fried rice — with night views of the lake.

name: Nelayan Kitchen
why: Fish head curry recipe inherited since 1965, served with a view of Masjid Besi across the lake.

name: Nasi Kandar Pokok Penang
why: 24-hour nasi kandar — reviewers rave about the RM 7.80 rice + ayam goreng + keropok + campur curry combo.

name: Food Valet
why: Neon-lit shipping-container food court by the skatepark — nasi lemak, char kway teow, cendol. Comes alive at night.

name: MyViets
why: Authentic Vietnamese by the lake — 10-hour pho bo broth, banh mi with lemongrass chicken, ciku milkshake.

name: Thai Kung Restaurant
why: Solid tomyam, steamed fish and pulut mangga in Presint 8 with a view of the government buildings.
